fields.PRODUCT NAME: Brass Kamdhenu Cow with Calf Idol ( 3inches)
fields.DESCRIPTION: Enhance the spiritual aura of your home with this exquisitely crafted Brass Kamdhenu Cow with Calf idol. In Hindu tradition, Kamdhenu is regarded as the divine cow, symbolizing prosperity, abundance, and motherly love. This handcrafted idol depicts the sacred cow with her calf, representing nurturing energy and blessings for the household.
